escenas.texto: We toured Oceania, Asia, Africa, Europe and the Americas. Now, the ranking that brings it all together: this week's global Top 10. This week in the World, millions of people watched, commented and shared non-stop. The thirty videos in this countdown add up to over eight hundred and thirteen million views. But only one took number one. Welcome to Top 10 Social Media, the World edition. Today: the ten most viewed, the ten most commented and the ten most liked videos of the week. Stay until the end, because you won't guess number one.

The world rules: the top three of every list from every continent compete here, the same videos and the same numbers from this Sunday's world tour. One video per creator on each list. Every number comes from the official YouTube API. Let's go.

Let's start with the ten most viewed videos. At number ten, from United States, Klimt, with “The Real Reason Celebrities Refuse to Sign With Blue Ink”. Over twenty-four million views. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and eighty thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just forty-three seconds.
In position number nine, from Austria, Red Bull, with “World's Biggest Human Catapult”. Over twenty-five million views. A Short of just twenty-six seconds. It got there in just one day.

Number eight, from Mexico, Fede Vigevani, with a video posted five days ago. Over twenty-seven million views. It has the best engagement rate on this list: three out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. A video over twenty-five minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.

In position number seven, from Georgia, Denis Shmalts, with “How the First Combat Submarine Actually Worked”. Over twenty-seven million views. A Short of just thirty-four seconds. It also has over two thousand comments.

Coming in at number six, SOS Pals, with “Ever parent needs this for their kids!”. Over twenty-nine million views. And get this: it's a channel with about thirteen thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just thirteen seconds.

Coming in at number five, from India, Sharmi’s Creation , with a video posted five days ago. Over thirty million views. A Short of just thirty-two seconds. It also has three hundred and ninety-six comments.

In position number four, Dino Says, with “Comment DINO if you want one!”. Over thirty-nine million views. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just nineteen seconds.

Bronze medal, Mohamed Gamal, with a video posted six days ago. Over sixty-six million views. And get this: it's a channel with about twenty-three thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just twenty-four seconds.
Silver medal, from United States, MrBeast, with “Trap Door Roulette”. Over seventy million views. A Short of just forty-eight seconds. It also has over nine thousand comments.

Drum roll, please. Number one most viewed, from India, Thar Desert Photography, with a video posted four days ago. Over seventy-two million views. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about six hundred and fifty thousand views per hour. A Short of just twenty-five seconds.

Now for the conversation: the ten most commented videos. Number ten, from Australia, NickandCarrie, with “Which one is your favourite?”. Over nine thousand comments. It also has over two point eight million views.
Next up, number nine, from Austria, Red Bull, with “World's Biggest Human Catapult”. Over nine thousand comments. A Short of just twenty-six seconds. It got there in just one day.
Number eight, from United Kingdom, Petya English, with a video posted six days ago. Over eleven thousand comments. It also has over nine point seven million views.
In position number seven, from United States, Paramount Pictures, with “The Angry Birds Movie 3 Official Trailer 2 2026 Movie”. Over twelve thousand comments. It also has over eleven million views.

In position number six, from India, Salman Khan Films, with a video posted one day ago. Over eighteen thousand comments. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about seven hundred and sixty thousand views per hour. It got there in just one day.
In position number five, from Türkiye, KARM6, with a video posted five days ago. Over nineteen thousand comments. It also has over two point one million views.

At number four, from Indonesia, Nadia Omara, with a video posted five days ago. Over nineteen thousand comments. A video over thirty-three minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over fifteen million views.

Bronze medal, from United States, Rockstar Games, with “Grand Theft Auto VI: Pre-Load Now”. Over twenty-one thousand comments. It has the best engagement rate on this list: six out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. A Short of just thirty seconds.
Silver medal, from Indonesia, Dhot Design, with a video posted six days ago. Over seventy-three thousand comments. It also has over eleven million views.

And finally, number one most commented, from Mexico, Fede Vigevani, with a video posted five days ago. Over eighty-nine thousand comments. A video over twenty-five minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over twenty-seven million views.

And the last list: the ten most liked videos. Next up, number ten, EltelwanyTV, with “Funniest Fan Chants in Football Bruno Rat Chant”. Over three hundred and forty-eight thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about twenty thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just forty-seven seconds.
Number nine, from India, Baccha Mat Bolna, with a video posted six days ago. Over four hundred and twenty-five thousand likes. It also has over nineteen million views.

Next up, number eight, from France, General Mole, with a video posted six days ago. Over four hundred and twenty-nine thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about fourteen thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has over twelve million views.

Coming in at number seven, from India, Thar Desert Photography, with a video posted four days ago. Over four hundred and forty-one thousand likes. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about six hundred and fifty thousand views per hour. A Short of just twenty-five seconds.
Coming in at number six, from United Kingdom, Petya English, with a video posted six days ago. Over four hundred and forty-two thousand likes. It also has over nine point seven million views.

In position number five, Zack D. Films, with “What If Bug-Man Grew Inside Purple Guy”. Over five hundred and thirty-three thousand likes. A Short of just fifty-two seconds. It also has over thirteen million views.
At number four, from Austria, Red Bull, with “World's Biggest Human Catapult”. Over six hundred and forty-four thousand likes. A Short of just twenty-six seconds. It got there in just one day.

Bronze medal, from United States, Sophia & Noelle, with “Okay but who wins?!”. Over six hundred and fifty-seven thousand likes. It has the best engagement rate on this list: five out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. It got there in just two days.

Silver medal, from Mexico, Fede Vigevani, with a video posted five days ago. Over seven hundred and twenty-seven thousand likes. A video over twenty-five minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over twenty-seven million views.

Drum roll, please. Number one most liked, from United States, MrBeast, with “Trap Door Roulette”. Over one point one million likes. A Short of just forty-eight seconds. It also has over seventy million views.

And that wraps up this week's world tour. Now it's your turn: which video should have made this countdown? Tell us in the comments with the hashtag Top10RS. Links to every original video are in the description: go support the creators. Subscribe and hit the bell. A new Top 10 every Sunday. And a question for you: do you want us to hold a real award for the Top 10 winners? If you do, write the hashtag Premios Top 10 RS in the comments, all in one word.
